name: lifer
description: Self-hosted, species-indexed life-list app for wildlife photography.

scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts e2e playwright.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test:unit -w data-pipeline && npm test -w @lifer/core -w api -w web -w mobile
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w api && playwright test
scripts.e2e:visual: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w api && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.visual.config.ts
scripts.screens: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w api && tsx e2e/screens/run.ts
scripts.e2e:visual:update: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w api && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.visual.config.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @lifer/core -w api -w data-pipeline && node scripts/coverage-summary.mjs
scripts.check:mobile: npm run check:ui -w mobile && npm run check:i18n -w mobile
scripts.check:all: npm run check:mobile && npm run check:raw-controls && npm run check:design-tokens && npm run check:token-export && npm run check:em-dashes && npm run check:i18n && npm run check:copy && npm run check:ux-code && npm run check:remembered-state
